summary: Frontend-only test of 'Meta En Imagen' feature: buildStreakCard now draws weekly goal card in canvas. Seeded 3 guest sessions in current week + weekly goal (3, then 5, then 0). All 4 scenarios verified: (1) modal opens & preview img is 1080x1350 blob with goal=3, (2) download button downloads 'racha-gymtrack.png', (3) after changing goal to 5 via home-goal-increase and reopening modal, preview regenerated 1080x1350 with new goal, (4) with weeklyGoal=0 the fallback single-card layout still generates 1080x1350 without error. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, no canvas exceptions.
seed_data_creation: localStorage 'gymtrack_guest_sessions' = 3 sessions in current week; 'gymtrack_weekly_goal' tested at 3, 5, and 0.
